notes:
Alpha

• Artist, title, and embedded artwork are read automatically in the background. Your edits are preserved, and refreshing a stack rereads metadata and duration.
• The player shows where a track is playing from. Playlists and stacks use their own artwork; library playback uses embedded artwork when available.
• Reorder the playback queue by dragging, move or remove queued tracks, and clear upcoming tracks. Play or Next can start an idle queue.
• Accent colors, stacks, and playlists share one preset color palette.
• Sort tracks by title or artist in either direction.
• Wider library views, more consistent icons, UI enchancements.
